headline: THE U2 FAN-OUT IS A PIN ASSIGNMENT, NOT A CORRIDOR: FOUR PCAL9535A CHANNELS SIT ON THE WRONG SIDE OF THE PACKAGE, AND EXCHANGING TWO PAIRS CLOSES /BQ25185_STAT1 AND HALVES /BQ25185_STAT2 IN EVERY RUN.  IT IS HELD BY A KNIFE-EDGE BQ25185_SYS FILL WHOSE CUT IS NOW BLAMED ON FOUR PRE-EXISTING OBJECTS.

1_the_finding.what: U2 is a TSSOP-24 PCAL9535A: pins 1-12 are its WEST column, 13-24 its EAST.  /BQ25185_STAT1 and /BQ25185_STAT2 arrive from U11/TP6/TP7 in the EAST (partner centroids x 67.3 and 59.4) and were landed on P05/P06, the WEST column; /SX1262_DIO1 (U8.13 at x 3.000) and /TOUCH_INT_N (J1.46 at x 22.410) arrive from the WEST and were landed on P17/P16, the EAST column.  ALL FOUR CROSS THE PACKAGE, and that crossing is why D-710 measured U2.9/U2.10/U2.11 sharing one conductor's worth of corridor.
1_the_finding.why_it_is_free: all four channels are INPUTS and all four targets were already inputs, so the direction registers 06h = E0h and 07h = FFh are UNCHANGED; every PCAL9535A channel is interrupt-capable; no part moves, no footprint changes, no BOM changes and no net gains or loses a member.  Only the bit position firmware reads moves, and the Demo firmware in Firmware/ carries no U2 channel map at all.

2_the_eco_is_authored_and_verified.script: evidence/d711-eco-u2-channel-swap.py -- re-applies it to 08_buttons_expanders.kicad_sch in one command: delete the two wires joining P05/P06 to R127's and R128's pull-up chains, move the SX1262_DIO1 and TOUCH_INT_N hierarchical labels onto P05's and P06's stubs, and add local BQ25185_STAT1 / BQ25185_STAT2 labels on P17's and P16's, which join R127's and R128's chains BY NAME so each net keeps exactly ONE hierarchical label
2_the_eco_is_authored_and_verified.netlist: kicad-cli export confirms /BQ25185_STAT1 = {R127.2, TP6.1, U11.9, U2.20}, /BQ25185_STAT2 = {R128.2, TP7.1, U11.3, U2.19}, /SX1262_DIO1 = {U2.9, U8.13}, /TOUCH_INT_N = {J1.46, U2.10}, every other U2 channel unchanged, 231 nets (evidence/d711-eco-netlist.net)
2_the_eco_is_authored_and_verified.erc: BYTE-IDENTICAL before and after -- 978 violations, same counts in every category, including the five PRE-EXISTING label_dangling errors (evidence/d711-erc-before-eco.json vs d711-erc-after-eco.json)
2_the_eco_is_authored_and_verified.status: REVERTED in the worktree, because a schematic ECO whose PCB half is not promotable would break schematic/PCB parity.  The script replays it.

3_what_it_buys_measured.s1: PCB pad swap 9<->20 only: STAT1 U11.9 -> U2.20 still NO_PATH -- ONE swap is not enough
3_what_it_buys_measured.blame_after_one_swap: with STAT1 on U2.20 the corridor has TWO single openers where it had one: /TOUCH_INT_N (34.311 mm / 2 vias) and /ACC_5V_SW_EN (37.998 mm / 5 vias, PROTECTED so not that one).  /TOUCH_INT_N is the net the SECOND swap moves to the west column anyway.
3_what_it_buys_measured.s2_s3_s4_s5_s6: BOTH swaps, /TOUCH_INT_N evicted whole and re-laid: /BQ25185_STAT1 ROUTES U11.9/R127.2 -> U2.20 in 25.981 mm / 4 vias, /BQ25185_STAT2 goes 2 -> 1 in 12.071 mm / 2 vias, /TOUCH_INT_N comes back SHORTER than it went (44.518 mm / 1 via against about 48 mm), failed_nets [], and the board reads 16 -> 14.  FIVE independent runs, identical figures.

4_the_one_clause_that_refuses_it.why_it_is_not_a_removal: no_unlicensed_removal PASSES and the SYS copper near the cut is BYTE-IDENTICAL before and after.  screen_pour_arm_path reports C24.1 -> U12.1 NOT_ONE_ISLAND, so the two are joined by the B.Cu FILL, and what moves is the REFILL retreating around new vias.
four_remedies_measured_and_refused: --repair-planes: plants a via at (66.375, 75.525) with a 0.025 mm stub -- a DANGLING via -- in every run, and does not close the split
requesting /01_POWER_TREE/BQ25185_SYS in the same transaction: NO_VIA_SITE, lays nothing
--join-islands --join-island-max-mm 8 --join-island-via 650000:400000: joined 0, nets [] -- both halves carry barrels, so neither is an ORPHAN island and this lever never sees them

two reserve geometries: the first (three discs on the SYS chain at 61.85,99.325 / 61.40,103.50 / 61.75,103.725) left STAT1's route BYTE-IDENTICAL and broke /TOUCH_INT_N; the second (three discs along the fill corridor to U12.1) moved STAT1 to 32.603 mm / 2 vias and made SYS regress TWICE with pour_partition REFUSED
4_the_one_clause_that_refuses_it.and_STAT1_is_not_the_cause: run s9 drops /BQ25185_STAT1 entirely and keeps only /BQ25185_STAT2 + /TOUCH_INT_N, and SYS STILL regresses 5 -> 6 with the SAME split and the SAME dangling via.  So the cut is not one route's fault; the fill there is already on a knife edge.

5_and_the_cut_IS_now_blamed_by_name.q1_upper_bound: SEVEN clusters with ALL 73 foreign objects in the window dropped
5_and_the_cut_IS_now_blamed_by_name.q3_minimal_set: FOUR objects, and it MATCHES the upper bound -- two `Net-(U12-PS_SYNC)` B.Cu tracks ((62.900,104.050)->(64.250,104.050) and (62.325,104.575)->(62.900,104.050), both 0.200 mm) and two 0.60/0.30 barrels, `/BQ25185_STAT2` at (63.200, 99.800) and `GND` at (64.100, 99.700)
5_and_the_cut_IS_now_blamed_by_name.worth: TWO SYS edges -- so the transaction that unblocks the pin swap also takes /01_POWER_TREE/BQ25185_SYS from FIVE open edges to THREE
5_and_the_cut_IS_now_blamed_by_name.spec_on_disk: evidence/d711-sys-cut-detours.json (the blame's own Q3 spec; note the router's --detour-spec wants a_mm/b_mm where the blame emits start_mm/end_mm)

6_next: ONE transaction: replay evidence/d711-eco-u2-channel-swap.py, apply the matching PCB pad swap, evict /TOUCH_INT_N whole, spend the FOUR-object SYS cut spec, and request /BQ25185_STAT1 + /BQ25185_STAT2 + /TOUCH_INT_N.  Arithmetic: STAT1 -1, STAT2 -1, SYS -2 => 15 -> 11.
It needs the barrel entries re-keyed to the router's a_mm/b_mm form and the /BQ25185_STAT2 barrel at (63.200, 99.800) handled as part of that net's own re-lay rather than a bare removal.
Everything else D-710 named still stands: U21's SOT-563 middle land for ACC_5V_LX (a PACKAGE question under D-703 option 4), and the BAT_PROTECTED_P hand taper for U11.
